sources.snippet: MiniMax H3 (GGUF Quantizations) This repository (molbal/MiniMax-H3-GGUF) provides GGUF quantized versions and necessary component files for the MiniMax H3 model. MiniMax H3 is a general-purpose, omni-modal generative system that supports unified understanding of multimodal contexts composed of text, images, video, and audio.
